methods.name: global_admin_reset
methods.desc:
Allows the contract creator to reset the global admin account.
Args: global_admin (Account): sets the administrator wallet for this contract.

methods.name: project_admin_reset
methods.desc:
Allows the asset admin to reset a new admin account.
Args: project_admin (Account): sets the administrator wallet for this asset.
